phase3_findings.description: The read-only-filesystem (errno.EROFS) branch of probe_memory that reports 'not writable by this process' has no test; a regression would only change the message wording, the probe still fails with exit 2.

A dangling chroma.sqlite3 symlink raises FileNotFoundError on the r+b open, so the probe passes as if no store existed; SQLite later follows the link and creates an empty store or fails at first memory query. Outside the issue's scope (criterion 2: absent file passes); untested.

On Windows, opening a directory raises PermissionError, so a chroma.sqlite3 path that is a directory would be reported as 'not writable by this process' and the directory test's negative assertions would fail. CI runs unit tests only on ubuntu-latest; issue records Windows behavior as not established.

test_probe_memory_constructs_no_chroma_client patches only chromadb.PersistentClient and nothing asserts no embedding-model download; the segment-directory test records only builtins.open. Criterion 4 holds today; the gap weakens regression detection only.
